title: Documents · a sheet's rows imported by code, each value with its cell, one file one document

steps.say: import the P&L sheet of RestoPros P&L Sept 2025.xlsx into a new table called ledger with account, amount and month
steps.reply:
I made a new **Ledger** table in Accounting and imported all 4 rows from the P&L sheet. Each amount is linked to the cell it came from.

| Account | Amount | Month |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | 48,200 | Sept |
| Cost of sales | 21,400 | Sept |
| Payroll | 12,800 | Sept |
| Rent | 3,500 | Sept |

Some things to know:
- **Months are text.** I kept "Sept" exactly as the sheet has it. The sheet doesn't give a year, but the file name says September 2025.
- **One row per account.** This import matched rows by account name. If you import another month's P&L the same way, October's Revenue would replace
